=== rt_curve_engine demo: event-driven rebuilds over the mc_interp_cuda curve registry ===

Loaded registry from ../mc_interp_cuda/static_metadata.json

Dependency graph (topological order):
  EUR_ESTR         <- (root)
  EUR_ESTR_IMMFUT  <- (root)
  EUR_ESTR_IMM     <- (root)
  EUR_ESTR_ECB     <- (root)
  USD_SOFR         <- (root)
  GBP_SONIA        <- (root)
  EUR_EURIBOR6M    <- EUR_ESTR
  EUR_USD_XCCY     <- USD_SOFR EUR_ESTR

--- Phase 1: initial quotes for all curves ---
  cycle: applied=24 stale=0 dup=0  -> epoch 1
    dirty  : EUR_ESTR EUR_ESTR_ECB EUR_ESTR_IMM EUR_ESTR_IMMFUT EUR_EURIBOR6M EUR_USD_XCCY GBP_SONIA USD_SOFR
    rebuilt: EUR_ESTR EUR_ESTR_IMMFUT EUR_ESTR_IMM EUR_ESTR_ECB USD_SOFR GBP_SONIA EUR_EURIBOR6M EUR_USD_XCCY  (topological order, each at most once)
  snapshot epoch 1  [coherent]
    EUR_ESTR         v1   OK               quoteSeqHW=3

    EUR_USD_XCCY     v1   OK               quoteSeqHW=24  EUR_ESTR@v1  USD_SOFR@v1
    GBP_SONIA        v1   OK               quoteSeqHW=21
    USD_SOFR         v1   OK               quoteSeqHW=18

--- Phase 2a: one EUR_ESTR tick (expect EURIBOR6M and XCCY to follow, nothing else) ---
  cycle: applied=1 stale=0 dup=0  -> epoch 2
    dirty  : EUR_ESTR
    rebuilt: EUR_ESTR EUR_EURIBOR6M EUR_USD_XCCY  (topological order, each at most once)

--- Phase 2b: one USD_SOFR tick (expect only XCCY to follow) ---
  cycle: applied=1 stale=0 dup=0  -> epoch 3
    dirty  : USD_SOFR
    rebuilt: USD_SOFR EUR_USD_XCCY  (topological order, each at most once)

--- Phase 2c: one GBP_SONIA tick (leaf: rebuilds alone) ---
  cycle: applied=1 stale=0 dup=0  -> epoch 4
    dirty  : GBP_SONIA
    rebuilt: GBP_SONIA  (topological order, each at most once)

--- Phase 3: duplicate and out-of-order ticks ---
  cycle: applied=1 stale=0 dup=0  -> epoch 5
    dirty  : EUR_ESTR
    rebuilt: EUR_ESTR EUR_EURIBOR6M EUR_USD_XCCY  (topological order, each at most once)
  now submit the SAME tick again (duplicate) and an OLDER seq (stale):
  cycle: applied=0 stale=0 dup=1  (nothing to rebuild)

--- Phase 4: EUR_ESTR solver failure ---
  cycle: applied=1 stale=0 dup=0  -> epoch 6
    dirty  : EUR_ESTR
    rebuilt: EUR_ESTR EUR_EURIBOR6M EUR_USD_XCCY  (topological order, each at most once)
    FAILED : EUR_ESTR
  snapshot epoch 6  [coherent]
    EUR_ESTR         v4   STALE_LAST_GOOD  quoteSeqHW=28
    EUR_ESTR_ECB     v1   OK               quoteSeqHW=15
    EUR_ESTR_IMM     v1   OK               quoteSeqHW=12
    EUR_ESTR_IMMFUT  v1   OK               quoteSeqHW=9
    EUR_EURIBOR6M    v4   OK               quoteSeqHW=6  EUR_ESTR@v4
    EUR_USD_XCCY     v5   OK               quoteSeqHW=24  EUR_ESTR@v4  USD_SOFR@v2
    GBP_SONIA        v2   OK               quoteSeqHW=27
    USD_SOFR         v2   OK               quoteSeqHW=26
  (EUR_ESTR serves last good, marked STALE_LAST_GOOD; its quote high water did not advance)

--- Phase 4b: solver recovers; retry happens on the next cycle without a new ESTR tick ---
  cycle: applied=1 stale=0 dup=0  -> epoch 7
    dirty  : EUR_ESTR GBP_SONIA
    rebuilt: EUR_ESTR GBP_SONIA EUR_EURIBOR6M EUR_USD_XCCY  (topological order, each at most once)
  snapshot epoch 7  [coherent]
    EUR_ESTR         v5   OK               quoteSeqHW=29
    EUR_ESTR_ECB     v1   OK               quoteSeqHW=15
    EUR_ESTR_IMM     v1   OK               quoteSeqHW=12
    EUR_ESTR_IMMFUT  v1   OK               quoteSeqHW=9
    EUR_EURIBOR6M    v5   OK               quoteSeqHW=6  EUR_ESTR@v5
    EUR_USD_XCCY     v6   OK               quoteSeqHW=24  EUR_ESTR@v5  USD_SOFR@v2
    GBP_SONIA        v3   OK               quoteSeqHW=30
    USD_SOFR         v2   OK               quoteSeqHW=26

--- Phase 5: threaded ECB-style burst (120 ticks across the ESTR complex) ---

  rebuild cycles triggered : 1  (coalescing: many ticks per cycle, each curve rebuilt at most once per cycle)
